svg.title: ContentHub Master Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Full-stack architecture: React frontend, Spring Boot microservices, Kafka event bus, AWS cloud infrastructure with EKS, security group firewall chain, and observability stack.
svg.text: AWS ALB-SG · public internet → ports 80/443 only
AWS EKS-Node-SG · Kubernetes on Fargate — no public internet
AWS DB-SG · accepts only EKS-Node-SG on 5432 / 27017
